Q3: raw_level is the pre-demosaic Bayer FBDD level (integer 0/1/2) and is modeled only on Mac (SDR RAW). Ends without the key (iOS/Android/Windows) ignore a non-zero value and show a one-time prompt instead of rejecting the paste; Mac still rejects non-zero when its target cannot represent it (SDR raster target).

Q3: post_rgb is post-render RGB denoise (0-1 float), the current HDR v6+ key; Mac and Android/Windows model it on HDR only, iOS on SDR+HDR (no SDR UI slider). Ends whose SDR path does not model the key (Mac, Android, Windows) ignore a non-zero value and show a one-time prompt instead of rejecting the paste; iOS keeps rejecting non-zero on raster targets. HDR denoise UI step is 0.1% on Mac/Windows, 1% on Android, and 5% (0.05) on iOS via AdjustmentKind.noiseReduction.
